label: Remove Logo
blurb: Hides a fixed logo, channel bug, watermark, timestamp or dust spot by filling a box with the picture round it: every pixel inside is blended from the four sides of the box, weighted by how near each side is, so gradients and skies carry straight through. A side on the frame edge is left out. Drag the box on the Program monitor, add a little grain so the patch does not look too clean, and keep the box just bigger than the mark.
